leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply CSS Modules to scope styles locally within a Vue component
Configure a Vue project to support CSS Modules without build tool conflicts
Bind scoped CSS classes to template elements using dynamic class objects
Manipulate component appearance by toggling CSS Modules classes with reactive data
Integrate multiple CSS Modules class bindings on a single element for combined styling
Construct a Vue component that uses CSS Modules for encapsulated, maintainable styling
